nodes.description: Registry contract holding addresses of all protocol components.
Reference to LendingPoolCore which custodies all funds.
Reference to LendingPoolDataProvider used for health factor calculations.
Reference to parameter provider (flashloan fees, stable borrow limits).
Authorised lending pool address used by onlyLendingPool guard.
Underlying reserve asset represented by the aToken.
Mapping of users to the address receiving their interest.
Per-user cumulative index used for balance computation.
Mutex counter used by the nonReentrant modifier.
Privileged owner address able to upgrade protocol implementations.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding implementation address, written via assembly sstore.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding proxy admin address, written via assembly sstore.
Mapping of reserve address to ReserveData struct with rates and indexes.
Mapping user/reserve to UserReserveData borrow position.
External payable deposit entrypoint; mints aTokens and moves funds into core.
Redeem entrypoint restricted to the overlying aToken which transfers liquidity to the user.
Borrow entrypoint performing collateral/health checks then transferring funds to msg.sender.
Payable repay entrypoint supporting repay on behalf of another user.
Liquidation entrypoint that delegatecalls the liquidation manager.
Flashloan entrypoint that transfers funds to an arbitrary receiver then calls back executeOperation.
External entrypoint to switch between stable and variable borrow rate.
Permissionless rebalance of a user's stable borrow rate.
External entrypoint toggling whether a deposit is used as collateral.
Transfers ERC20 or ETH out of core to a user-supplied address.
Payable function pulling tokens/ETH into core and refunding excess ETH.
Payable function forwarding repay/fee liquidity to the fee collector.
Payable function sending liquidated origination fees to the fee address.
Updates reserve indexes, timestamp and rates after a flashloan.
External redeem that burns aTokens and calls pool.redeemUnderlying.
Overridden ERC20 transfer applying whenTransferAllowed gating.
Internal balance-cumulation plus aToken transfer logic.
Redirects another user's interest, guarded by an allowance mapping.
Only-lending-pool mint hook executed on deposit.
Only-lending-pool aToken transfer during liquidation.
Only-lending-pool burn of aTokens on liquidation.
Mutex modifier guarding state-changing pool entrypoints.
Modifier restricting functions to the contract owner.
Modifier routing admin callers to the function and others to the fallback.
Admin-only upgrade that writes the implementation slot and delegatecalls init data.
Fallback logic delegating all calldata to the implementation.
Owner-only internal routine creating or upgrading protocol component proxies.
Public initializer setting logic and admin on an uninitialized proxy.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, ownership and beneficiary checks.
Block timestamp used for interest accrual and reserve last-update bookkeeping.
Assembly delegatecall forwarding arbitrary calldata to the implementation.
Admin-supplied calldata executed via delegatecall on a new implementation.
delegatecall into the liquidation manager preserving pool storage and msg.sender.
Low-level call.value(50000 gas) sending ETH to a user-supplied payable address.
Low-level call.value refund of excess ETH to the caller-supplied user address.
Low-level call.value sending ETH fees to the fee collection address.
Low-level call.value sending liquidated ETH fees to the destination.
External call into attacker-controlled receiver before repayment verification.
receiver.transfer() sending ETH to the registered token distributor.
Assembly sstore writing the implementation address into the EIP-1967 slot.
User-supplied deposit amount.
Reserve address selected by the caller.
Referral identifier emitted in the Deposit event.
Underlying amount requested to be redeemed.
Amount the borrower wants to borrow.
Requested interest rate mode (stable or variable).
Address whose debt is being repaid.
Recipient address for ETH/token transfer out of core.
Amount transferred to the user.
Caller-supplied address receiving any excess ETH refund.
Amount to be pulled into the reserve.
Borrower being liquidated.
Arbitrary contract receiving the flashloaned funds.
Opaque data forwarded to the receiver callback.
Amount requested in the flashloan.
Account whose interest stream is redirected by an approved caller.
New implementation address for a protocol component.
Implementation contract address set during upgrade.
Arbitrary calldata delegatecalled on the new implementation.
Initial implementation address set by the initializer.
Initial admin address stored into the ADMIN_SLOT.
New proxy admin address supplied by the current admin.
Computed repay amount limited by compounded borrow plus fees.
Casted interest rate mode derived from user input.
Collateral balance after the requested decrease, used for liquidation threshold math.
Accrued interest minted to the user during cumulation.
Flag enabling collateral usage on a user's first deposit.
Post-callback liquidity snapshot used to verify repayment.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the deposit beneficiary and first-deposit check.
onlyOverlyingAToken compares msg.sender with the reserve aToken address.
msg.sender determines the borrower position and collateral checks.
msg.sender is recorded as the repayer in the Repay event.
msg.sender becomes the liquidator inside the delegatecalled liquidation manager.
Collateral toggle is performed on behalf of msg.sender's position.
onlyLendingPool requires lendingPoolAddress == msg.sender before sending funds out.
onlyLendingPool guard and excess-ETH refund target derive from the caller context.
interestRedirectionAllowances[_from] is compared against msg.sender.
isOwner() compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
ifAdmin gates upgrade functions on msg.sender == _admin().
onlyOwner restricts implementation updates to the owner caller.
Anyone can call the initializer if the proxy is still uninitialized.
block.timestamp is emitted in the Deposit event and drives rate accrual.
Timestamp is emitted in the RedeemUnderlying event.
Interest accrual and event timestamps depend on block.timestamp.
Repay events and user lastUpdateTimestamp are set from block.timestamp.
Liquidation events use block.timestamp.
FlashLoan event timestamp is block.timestamp.
reserve.lastUpdateTimestamp is written from block.timestamp.
aToken balance cumulation derives interest from block.timestamp.
nonReentrant mutex protects deposit.
nonReentrant mutex protects borrow.
nonReentrant mutex protects repay.
nonReentrant mutex protects liquidationCall.
nonReentrant mutex protects flashLoan.
onlyOwner gates the implementation update path.
ifAdmin gates upgradeToAndCall.
deposit calls aToken.mintOnDeposit for the depositor.
deposit forwards value to core.transferToReserve.
redeemUnderlying transfers the redeemed asset to the user.
borrow transfers the borrowed asset to msg.sender.
repay pushes the principal back into the reserve.
repay forwards origination fees to the fee collection address.
liquidationCall delegatecalls the external liquidation manager.
flashLoan sends liquidity to the receiver before the callback.
flashLoan settles reserve state after repayment verification.
flashLoan invokes executeOperation on the untrusted receiver mid-execution.
aToken.redeem makes an external call into pool.redeemUnderlying which sends ETH/tokens.
_transfer delegates to executeTransferInternal.
transferOnLiquidation reuses executeTransferInternal.
updateImplInternal calls proxy.upgradeToAndCall on existing component proxies.
_fallback delegates all calldata to the implementation.
upgradeToAndCall executes delegatecall with admin-supplied data.
upgradeToAndCall writes the implementation slot through _setImplementation.
assembly sstore writes IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
delegatecall executes against the newly written implementation slot.
initialize writes the implementation slot via _setImplementation.
initialize writes the admin slot from a caller-supplied address.
The receiver callback returns control into the lending pool before balances are verified.
Pool-controlled recipient address receives ETH via a low-level call.
Transfer amount flows into the low-level ETH send.
Excess ETH is refunded to the caller-supplied user address via call.value.
msg.value.sub(_amount) computes the excess to refund.
Admin-supplied implementation becomes the delegatecall target.
Arbitrary calldata is executed through delegatecall.
Initializer writes the caller-supplied logic address as implementation.
Initializer writes the caller-supplied admin into the admin slot.
changeAdmin and upgradeToAndCall share the same admin-gated proxy control path.
Attacker-chosen receiver contract is invoked as the flashloan callback target.
User-supplied params are forwarded to the receiver callback.
Requested amount determines the funds sent before the callback.
New component implementation is installed through the proxy upgrade path.
paybackAmount is derived from user input and limits the repayment.
rateMode is cast from user input and selects borrow behaviour.
Post-decrease collateral balance feeds liquidation threshold arithmetic.
Accrued interest is minted/burned during redeem accounting.
isFirstDeposit controls collateral enablement on deposit.
availableLiquidityAfter is compared to the pre-flashloan balance plus fee.
User-supplied interest rate mode param is cast into the local rateMode.
_from determines whose allowance mapping is checked.
Deposit amount flows into state update, minting and transfer.
Reserve address selects the reserve state updated by the deposit.
Referral code is emitted with the deposit event.
Redeem amount is validated against available liquidity and transferred.
_onBehalfOf selects whose borrow state is repaid.
_user selects the undercollateralized account to liquidate.
Borrow amount drives collateral and fee calculations.

normalization_plan.reason: deposit amount parameter is only meaningful within LendingPool.deposit.
reserve parameter is only meaningful within LendingPool.deposit.
referral code parameter is only used by LendingPool.deposit.
redeem amount parameter is only meaningful within LendingPool.redeemUnderlying.
borrow amount parameter is only meaningful within LendingPool.borrow.
interest rate mode parameter is only used by LendingPool.borrow.
_onBehalfOf parameter is only meaningful within LendingPool.repay.
recipient parameter directly feeds the unsafe ETH call.value in transferToUser.
amount parameter directly feeds the unsafe ETH call.value in transferToUser.
user parameter receives the excess-ETH refund through the unsafe call.value.
amount parameter is subtracted from msg.value for the unsafe refund call.
liquidated user parameter is only meaningful within LendingPool.liquidationCall.
receiver parameter is the target of the unsafe flashloan callback.
params are forwarded verbatim into the unsafe flashloan callback.
amount parameter determines funds sent before the unsafe callback.
_from parameter is only meaningful within AToken.redirectInterestStreamOf.
new implementation parameter terminates in the proxy upgrade/delegatecall path.
newImplementation parameter is the target of the unsafe delegatecall.
data parameter is the payload of the unsafe delegatecall.
logic parameter is consumed by the proxy initializer.
admin parameter is consumed by the proxy initializer.
new admin parameter belongs to the admin-gated proxy control path.
paybackAmount local only exists inside LendingPool.repay.
rateMode local only exists inside LendingPool.borrow.
collateral-after-decrease local is produced inside the collateral-gating flow.
balanceIncrease local is used in the aToken redeem accounting.
isFirstDeposit local only exists inside LendingPool.deposit.
availableLiquidityAfter local only exists inside LendingPool.flashLoan.
